articles.title: Victrex (LSE:VCT) Stock Still Looks Below Fair Value After 60% Run
articles.summary: Victrex has delivered a sharp 60.3% return over the past year, which puts a spotlight on whether that share price now lines up with the cash the business can realistically generate. With the stock having moved this far, investors are increasingly asking if its cash flows support where the market is pricing it today. The 60.3% gain over the past 12 months means anyone looking at Victrex today is effectively judging whether that move is backed by the strength and durability of its cash...
